patients.summary: 58-year-old warehouse logistics coordinator with a bicuspid aortic valve and moderate aortic stenosis found in 2023, who had an acute type A aortic dissection in November 2025 repaired with a Bentall bioprosthetic root and hemiarch replacement; now on surveillance, back at work.

documents.title: New patient intake
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, I filled out the intake forms online and signed the records release for my old doctor's office. I'm booked for the 14th. I don't take any medications. Do I need to fast for that visit? Thanks, Piotr

documents.title: Re: New patient intake
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Thanks Piotr, forms received and the release went out by fax this morning. Please fast after midnight so we can draw labs at the visit. Water and black coffee are fine. See you Tuesday.

documents.title: New Patient Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
53 y/o man here to establish care. Previously seen at a primary care office in the area; that physician retired and he never found a replacement until now. Records requested, release signed last week.

No active complaints. Walks a fair amount at work, no exercise program beyond that. Sleeps fine. Mood good.

PMH: none. No surgeries.
Meds: none. No supplements.
Allergies: no known drug allergies.
FH: father has a bicuspid aortic valve, found when he was 50. Paternal uncle died at 64 of a ruptured ascending aortic aneurysm. Mother has high blood pressure.
SH: logistics coordinator at a warehouse, runs inbound scheduling and the floor crew. Lives alone in Williamsburg. Never smoked. A beer or two most weeks. No drugs.

Prevention per patient and prior office: colonoscopy around 2018, told normal. Tdap about five years ago. COVID vaccines x2 this spring at a pharmacy clinic. Never had shingles vaccine.

ROS: negative in detail.

Exam: vitals as charted. Well, pleasant. HEENT unremarkable. Neck supple, no adenopathy, thyroid not palpable. Heart regular rate and rhythm. Lungs clear bilaterally. Abdomen soft, nontender, no masses. No edema, pulses 2+ symmetric. Skin without concerning lesions. Neuro grossly nonfocal.

PHQ-2 0. AUDIT-C 2.

A/P: healthy 53 y/o establishing care.
- Fasting labs today: CBC, CMP, lipids, A1c. One-time hep C and HIV screens, he agrees.
- Shingrix #1 today, #2 in 2-6 months, nurse visit.
- Flu shot when this season's supply arrives in October.
- Colonoscopy: confirm date and result from records; if 2018 and normal, next due 2028.
- Tdap: confirm in records.
Return for physical in a year.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Piotr, everything from Tuesday came back normal: blood counts, kidney and liver function, sugar, and cholesterol. Hepatitis C and HIV screens were negative, and those don't need repeating. We'll get your second shingles shot scheduled for late November.

documents.title: Prior primary care records
documents.author: front desk
documents.body:
Fax received from prior primary care office, 38 pages, scanned to chart.

Summary for reviewer (RN abstract):
- Annual physicals 2014 through 2019, no problem list entries, no prescriptions.
- Labs 2017 and 2019: CBC, CMP, lipids normal.
- Screening colonoscopy 2018-03-22: normal to cecum, no polyps, good prep. Recall 10 years.
- Tdap 2016-05-10.
- COVID-19 Pfizer 2021-03-27 and 2021-04-17 (state registry printout in packet).
- Allergies: NKDA.
Nothing else of note. Routed to PCP.

documents.title: Nurse Visit: Flu Vaccine
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Here after work for flu vaccine. No fever today, no prior reactions. Quadrivalent flu 0.5 mL IM left deltoid. VIS given. Tolerated well, waited 15 min. Shingrix #2 booked 11/30.

documents.title: COVID booster
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Got the Pfizer booster at the pharmacy this morning. Can you add it to my record? Arm's a little sore, otherwise fine.

documents.title: Nurse Visit: Shingrix #2
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Shingrix dose 2 IM right deltoid. Dose 1 was 9/14, felt tired for a day after it. Pharmacy COVID booster 11/20 entered. Series complete. No complaints.

documents.title: Missed appointment
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Pt no-show for 8:30 physical. Reached him at work, says he mixed up the date with a truck audit. Rebooked 9/29 8:00, fasting.

documents.title: Annual Physical
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Annual. 54M, no problems, no meds, NKDA.

Feels well. Busy year, they added a second shift. No complaints when asked about chest, breathing, GI, GU, joints, skin, mood.
Still never smoked, alcohol unchanged, about 1-2 drinks a week.

Exam: vitals as charted. NAD. Heart RRR. Lungs clear. Abd soft, nontender. No edema. Skin ok.
PHQ-2 0.

Plan:
- Fasting CBC, CMP, lipids, A1c.
- Flu vaccine today.
- Bivalent COVID booster at pharmacy when convenient.
- Colonoscopy up to date (2018), next 2028. Tdap 2016, due 2026. Shingrix done.
RTC 1 yr.

documents.title: Lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs from yesterday all normal, nothing to change. Cholesterol in a good range for you. Next set at next year's physical.

documents.title: Outside immunization report
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Immunization registry update: Pfizer bivalent COVID-19 booster given 10/22/2022 at a community pharmacy. Entered in immunization history.
